title: Crear una identidad
goal: Read about the contradiction at the heart of 19th-century nation-building: celebrating Aztec imagery as a symbol while pursuing policies hostile to living indigenous communities.

items: Explain where Mexico's eagle-and-serpent symbol comes from.
Describe the contradiction between symbolic imagery and indigenous communities' real situation.
Explain why elites benefited from framing the pre-Hispanic past as 'closed off'.
Explain whether this tension was unique to Mexico.
Use subjunctive after expressions of necessity and evaluation.
